request.prompt:
Create a beautifully restrained PIXEL ART website profile banner on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. This is for SMALL WORLDS WORKSHOP, a parent and child making imaginative little games together. It will float over an existing dark navy #121F2E website background with small scattered pixel planets and islands. It must integrate naturally into that background, not look like a rectangular screenshot pasted onto it.

COMPOSITION: just THREE main elements, in one compact cohesive scene: a warmly illuminated open sketchbook in the lower center, ONE tiny floating grassy island with a single little tree emerging magically above the pages, and ONE very small sleeping orange cat curled beside the sketchbook as a secondary cameo. No other props: no desk lamp, no stools, no controller, no pencils, no rockets, no globe, no stacks of books, no castle. Intimate, uncluttered, enchanting. The sketchbook and island are the focus. Original sophisticated crisp pixel art, intentional visible square pixel clusters, warm honey gold #F2B66D and cream #F5E8CE illumination, restrained turquoise #8BD5CA, deep navy #121F2E shadows. Warm and magical, not photorealistic or a smooth digital painting.

CRITICAL EDGE TREATMENT: the sketchbook rests on a tiny suggested patch of magical ground, NOT on a rectangular tabletop or full-width shelf. The ground and the lower edges of the scene magically disintegrate into scattered square pixels and small pixel clusters, transitioning from solid pixel clusters near the artwork to sparse isolated warm gold and dark teal square particles, and finally to COMPLETE TRANSPARENCY. BOTH SIDES and especially the BOTTOM must dissolve in this pixelated way. Make the silhouettes irregular, soft in density but crisp in pixel shape. No straight cutoffs, no hard horizontal baseline, no rectangular boundary, no continuous opaque background, no enclosing silhouette, no oval dark shadow. No blurry gradient fades; use deliberate dithering and drifting square-pixel fragments with transparent gaps. Keep all scattered particles comfortably inside the canvas so absolutely nothing is cut off by any canvas edge. The area above the island and around all artwork must be genuinely empty transparent alpha, NOT a drawn checkerboard.

LAYOUT FOR A WIDE BANNER: canvas 1536x1024. Put ALL visible artwork and every last particle within x=200..1336 and y=240..784, leaving at least 200 transparent pixels on both sides and 240 transparent pixels above and below. Within that region arrange the three elements as a WIDE LOW composition, not a tall stack: the small island floats a little above the left-center of the open book, and the tiny sleeping cat sits to the right. The entire scene including particles is approximately twice as wide as tall. It will be cropped to a wide banner using only the transparent margins; no object should touch the crop. No words, letters, title, typography, logo, watermark, border or frame. Output transparent PNG artwork, not a mockup.
